phase: E1.1 final — adversarial review against the FROZEN tree (25 required lenses)
method: Each lens is an attempt to REFUTE the certification. A lens 'HOLDS' only when a real measurement or source probe defeats the attack. Refutations from the previous attempt are retained, not erased.
supersedes: The earlier 20-lens review of the pre-freeze attempt; its findings are preserved in E1_1_CONCURRENT_WORKSTREAM_BLOCKER.md.

lenses.lens: Source moves between tests and build
lenses.detail: Snapshot D (post-fix) = Snapshot E (post-build): content AND mtime digests identical, 0 diffs. The whole-tree detector reports 0 changes during the build window. The build measured the tree that was actually tested.

The previous attempt's RED->GREEN oscillation (TS2552, another session's half-finished cronSecret->cronSecrets refactor) is recorded in frozen-repository-proof.json and the blocker report. In THIS attempt tsc was measured green repeatedly on a tree that never moved.

It WAS absent: PRODUCTION_AUTHORIZED appeared nowhere in the partner surface (grep: 0 hits), while .env.example:495 promised it blocked live payouts. defaultPayoutDeps now composes Boolean(PRODUCTION_AUTHORIZED) && isPartnerLivePayoutAuthorized(). 13 regression tests added; defaultPayoutDeps previously had ZERO coverage — which is why the gap survived.

EXHAUSTIVE PROOF: all 2^7 = 128 subsets of the fully-authorized live environment were swept; NONE yields productionAuthorized() === true while the const floor is false. The env gate is AND-ed AFTER the floor — it can only add restrictions, never remove one.
sk_live_ alone -> stripeIsLive() true but productionAuthorized() false. The key shape sets the MODE, never the AUTHORIZATION. Tested.

Every PayoutDeps function is ZERO-ARITY (productionAuthorized.length === 0, stripeIsLive.length === 0, stripeMode.length === 0) — there is no channel through which a request body could influence them. stripeMode is derived from the server-side key prefix. Asserted in test section 2.

/api/cron/partner-payouts uses defaultPayoutDeps — which now consumes the P10 floor. It additionally requires a configured cron secret (503 if absent), a timing-safe match (401 otherwise), and PARTNER_PAYOUTS_ENABLED. Dry-run is the default.

lenses.lens: Admin route executes a real payout
lenses.detail: src/app/api/partners/admin/action/route.ts calls runMonthlyPayouts with dryRunOverride: true — a forced preview. The admin surface CANNOT execute a transfer.

runMonthlyPayouts delegates to previewPayouts (SELECT-only). No transfer, no batch row, no paid status, no email, no fake stripe id — and no run lock (a simulation must never block the real payout). Proven by payout-automation.itest.ts (98/98, PGlite).

lenses.lens: Commission marked paid before Stripe evidence
lenses.detail: settle() — which sets commission_entries.status='paid' — is invoked ONLY after deps.createTransfer() resolves. A failure never leaves a commission 'paid' but unfunded.

Deterministic key partner-payout:<partnerId>:<periodKey>:<batchHash> (batchHash = sha256 of SORTED entry ids, order-independent) passed to Stripe as idempotencyKey; plus a run lock (on conflict (run_key) do nothing) and uq_pp_item_entry_live. Two workers -> one transfer; replay -> no duplicate. Integration-proven.

A timeout/unknown outcome -> status reconciliation_required: releases NOTHING, pays NOTHING, and the entries stay locked to that batch. Stripe is queried (findTransfer, same idempotency key + batch_hash) BEFORE any recreation.

The stripe_mode filter lives IN THE SQL SELECTION (and e.stripe_mode = $2), not in an application-level filter someone can forget. assertHomogeneousBatch additionally rejects mixed_stripe_mode, mixed_currency and currency_mismatch_with_payout_account.

lenses.lens: Migration file treated as remotely applied
lenses.detail: partnerPayoutMigrationAppliedRemotely = false and p941AppliedRemotely = false — both hard-typed false. File presence (and passing tests) never implies remote application. Both remain remoteState: UNKNOWN.

The command center gates readyForRemoteMigrationAuthorization on CURRENT stability: if the tree moved after the tsc/test/build proofs were produced, those proofs describe a tree that no longer exists and authorize nothing. Every proof here was regenerated from CURRENT commands on the frozen tree — no historical count reused.

.next was removed; exactly ONE serialized build ran; exit 0; compiled; type validation; route validation; 192/192 static pages; 392 routes. D = E proves the source did not move during it. Compilation success followed by a route-validation failure would NOT have counted as green.

c14AccessGateReady probes the CURRENT source: AUTHENTICATED_DISCOVERY remains open, while ENTITLEMENT_REQUIRED and COMPANY_REQUIRED gate operational use. The if (!access) truthiness bug remains absent. CloneChat suite 436/436.
Operational access requires BOTH the Pierre entitlement and a company; the discriminated access union is intact (source-probed, not assumed).

Source probe: const useModel = pubReservation.granted && !!key && cfg.enabled — no model call without a granted reservation. The reserved-before-provider ordering is a MEASURED logical clock, not a hardcoded true. No new OpenAI call was made this session: no C1.4 RUNTIME file changed after the existing real-provider proof.

lenses.lens: Secret or database URL included in a proof
lenses.detail: Scanned every E1.1 proof and report against openai / stripe-live / stripe-test / webhook / resend key patterns, postgres URLs, JWTs and service-role values: 0 real secrets. The single regex hit was a FALSE POSITIVE — a previous proof literally DESCRIBING the pattern being scanned for (a 'postgres://' string with a Unicode ellipsis), not a value. The remote preflight prints no URL and no credential.

PRODUCTION_AUTHORIZED = false as const — comparing it to true is a TYPE ERROR (TS2367), so the compiler itself defends the floor. paymentMode = disabled. liveProvidersBlocked = true. partnerPayoutLiveAuthorized = false. No live Stripe call, no live payout, no live email / signature / voice / telephony.
The preflight ran WITHOUT --connect: connected false, mutationsExecuted 0, urlPrinted false, migrationState UNKNOWN. remoteDatabaseMutated = false (hard-typed).

deploymentPerformed = false (hard-typed). A green build is not a deployment. readyForControlledDeployment = true means PREFLIGHT ready, NOT production authorization — deploying remains an explicit, separate owner decision, and PRODUCTION_AUTHORIZED stays false.
